public_holidays: Nossa Senhora da Penha: state holiday. In 2026 it was Monday 13 April, the Monday after Easter; the 2027 date is not yet published (the Monday after Easter 2027 would be 5 April, to be confirmed by the 2027 decree)
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here. The state decree also lists 23 May (Colonização do Solo Espírito-santense) as an optional day only.
